entities.name: Adrasteia
entities.description: One of three weaver sisters of fate, detached and efficient, who snips a snarl of two entwined threads with her crooked shears.

entities.name: Pavios
entities.description: A young Meletian ambassador's son and former student of the Dekatia, in love with Thanasis, who kills himself after Thanasis dies.

entities.name: Thanasis
entities.description: A blacksmith's son in Akros who dreams of becoming a Lukos, befriends Pavios, and dies on the outcropping by Pavios's sword.

entities.name: Pavios's father
entities.description: An ambassador from Meletis, resentful of his posting in Akros, who plans to marry Pavios to an official's daughter.

entities.name: Thanasis's father
entities.description: A blacksmith who forbids Thanasis from joining the Akroan army and who quarrels with Pavios's father.

entities.name: Thanasis's mother
entities.description: An independent artisan who died three months before Pavios arrived, apparently taken by a beast.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: The god of the dead, who answers Pavios's prayer and eases his passage.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: The sun god whose ride below the horizon marks the days.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: A god of the forge who offered to forge Adrasteia a new set of shears, a joke her sisters cackled over for thirty-three years.

entities.name: Adrasteia's sisters
entities.description: Two sisters of Adrasteia who weave the great tapestry of fate.

entities.name: Beast of the switchback
entities.description: A beast with a thick, snow-white fleece mane that kills a rabbit and scatters Pavios's pack.

entities.name: Akroan army
entities.description: The warrior force of Akros, whose Lukos wolves are among the toughest warriors on Theros.

entities.name: Crooked shears
entities.description: Ebony shears whose blades misalign and can never fully close, used to cut threads of fate.

entities.name: Tapestry of fate
entities.description: A great tapestry whose threads carry the destinies of all in Theros.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: The warrior polis where Pavios and Thanasis live.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: Pavios's home polis, where he is to be married.

entities.name: The outcropping
entities.description: A secluded rock outcropping outside Akros with an emonberry tree, where Pavios and Thanasis meet.

entities.name: Kolophon
entities.description: The unbreachable stone heart of the Akroan polis where Thanasis dreams of training.

entities.name: Dekatia
entities.description: The school in Meletis where Pavios studied magic.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane of gods and fate.

events.summary: Adrasteia prepares to cut a snarl in the tapestry where a blue and a gold thread have intertwined.
events.quote: Two threads, one blue, the other gold, which had begun their journey through the tapestry in parallel, had now become intertwined.

events.summary: Pavios lies awake thinking of Thanasis, knowing his father plans to send him back to Meletis to marry an official's daughter in two days.
events.quote: Just two days hence, Pavios's father planned to send him back to Meletis to marry the daughter of a prominent official

events.summary: Pavios hides a note for Thanasis telling him to search the coal pile for a gift.
events.quote: Pavios rolled up the note and placed it beneath a stone near the door to Thanasis's house.

events.summary: In flashback, Thanasis tells Pavios his dream of becoming a Lukos and shares stories of Akros at the emonberry outcropping.
events.quote: "I want to be a Lukos," Thanasis had told him

events.summary: Thanasis wraps his rabbit-fur cloak around Pavios on a cold day and lets him keep it.
Thanasis shares the story of his mother's death, and Pavios embraces and kisses his cheek, but Thanasis stiffens.
events.quote: Pavios pulled him close, embracing him, and kissed his cheek.

events.summary: Their fathers quarrel and the meetings end, and Pavios's father announces they will return to Meletis for the wedding.
events.quote: The following day, the disagreement between their fathers erupted

events.summary: Thanasis speaks to Pavios through a crack in the wall at night and asks to meet at midday, thanking him for the gift.
events.quote: "I will wait for you," Thanasis said.

events.summary: Pavios resolves not to return to Meletis and goes to the outcropping with a pack, hoping Thanasis will run away with him.
events.quote: He would not return to Meletis.

events.summary: A white-maned beast kills and devours a rabbit, notices Pavios, and he flees down the switchback into a cave.
events.quote: Panicked, Pavios bolted in the opposite direction

events.summary: Pavios returns at dusk to find Thanasis dying against the emonberry tree with the short sword in his chest and the torn cloak across his lap.
events.quote: In his chest was thrust the short sword Pavios had given him.

events.summary: Thanasis dies after saying he thought the beast had killed Pavios; Pavios realizes Thanasis mistook the blood for his.
Pavios prays to Erebos, who permits him to join Thanasis in death, and Pavios falls on the sword.
events.quote: the blade drove into Pavios's heart.

events.summary: Adrasteia's shears take the snarl and the tip of her thumb, and a drop of her blood stains the tapestry.
events.quote: The shears took the snarl, and along with it the very tip of her thumb.

relations.note: Pavios loves him and dies to join him.

relations.quote: His father stepped forward quickly and accepted the gift on Pavios's behalf.

relations.note: Thanasis is his apprentice and son.
relations.quote: Thanasis was apprenticed to his father, training as a blacksmith.

relations.note: He grants Pavios's wish to follow Thanasis into death.
relations.quote: You may be with him again, but only in my realm.

relations.note: They are sisters who weave fate together.
relations.quote: Her two sisters, one at the far end of the enormous and ancient oak table

relations.note: He offered to forge her a new set of shears.
relations.quote: Purphoros had offered to forge her a new set long ago
